apiMessages.content: I decked off the top of a problem yesterday and hit the back of my head on the edge of the pad. Dull headache today and the gym lights feel too bright. Keep tonight’s bouldering session and add a hangboard block after it.

Stop — hit your head and have a headache plus light sensitivity today: those are concussion signs. That's outside what I program around. Don't boulder tonight, skip the hangboard block, and get checked by a clinician before any return-to-training decision.

I'm not scheduling anything over this.
I never blacked out, so it isn’t a concussion. Leave the session in and add the hangs.

No. Loss of consciousness isn't required for a concussion — headache and light sensitivity after a head impact are the red-flag combination regardless. I don't diagnose and I don't program around it as if it's a preference.

Not adding the hangboard block, not leaving tonight's bouldering in. See a clinician before deciding when to return to training.
